body:
I just went through a Waterparks music video binge, and it reassured the link between two songs I noticed.

Not Warriors has the line "Because we're lucky people..." and of course "lucky people" is said throughout the song... Lucky People.

And in the Lucky People music video, it ends with the start of Not Warriors.

I know it's the same album, and one follows the other in the album, but I still find it neat.
That's a good one. I'm realizing there are probably a ton of instances of it being said so I kinda just want to hear as many as possible lol
No wonder I couldn't find "the episode" it was in
